ISIN.name: ISIN
ISIN.definition: Code used to identify the financial instrument.

TradingDateTime.name: Trading Date Time
TradingDateTime.definition: Date and time when the transaction was executed.

TradingVenue.name: Trading Venue
TradingVenue.definition: Data related to the venue where the transaction was executed.

ThirdCountryTradingVenueIdentification.name: Third Country Trading Venue Identification
ThirdCountryTradingVenueIdentification.definition: Identification of the third-country trading venue where the transaction was executed.

TransactionIdentification.name: Transaction Identification
TransactionIdentification.definition: Alphanumerical code assigned by trading venues and Approved Publication Arrangements (APAs) and used in any subsequent reference to the underlying trade.||Usage: Only applicable for the Bond Consolidated Tape Provider (CTP).

NumberOfTransactions.name: Number Of Transactions
NumberOfTransactions.definition: Number of transactions executed when deferred publication of details of several transactions in an aggregated form is required.||Usage: Only applicable for the Bond Consolidated Tape Provider (CTP).

TradingSystemType.name: Trading System Type
TradingSystemType.definition: Type of trading system on which the transaction was executed.

Price.name: Price
Price.definition: Traded price of the transaction excluding, where applicable, commission and accrued interest. ||Usage: Only applicable for the Bond Consolidated Tape Provider (CTP).

Quantity.name: Quantity
Quantity.definition: Quantity being executed, when there is a partial or full execution.||Usage: Only applicable for the Equity Consolidated Tape Provider (CTP).

NotionalAmount.name: Notional Amount
NotionalAmount.definition: Notional amount that is denominated.||Usage: Only applicable for the Bond Consolidated Tape Provider (CTP).

Contributor.name: Contributor
Contributor.definition: Data related to the transaction published by a contributor.

ConsolidatedTapeProvider.name: Consolidated Tape Provider
ConsolidatedTapeProvider.definition: Data related to the Consolidated Tape Provider.||Usage: Only applicable for output data.

PostTradeData.name: Post Trade Data
PostTradeData.definition: Flags related to the post-trade related report.

SuspiciousData.name: Suspicious Data
SuspiciousData.definition: Indicates when the Consolidated Tape Provider (CTP) have identified trades that, in their view, might be subject to data quality issues.||Usage: Only applicable for output data.
